title: Film Leader
description: A 35mm canister on a light table. Pull the leader and a strip of colour negative unspools with its curl memory, sprocket holes and edge print, then curls slowly back when you let go.
intent: One physical material finished to the edge: real acetate negative with an orange mask, backlit by a light table, that you draw out of the canister by hand until the end of the roll is light-struck.
